parameters.n_groups: <int> Number of disjoint groups from which exactly one item must be selected.
parameters.m_resources: <int> Number of shared resources, each with a limited capacity.
parameters.n_items_per_group: <int> Number of candidate items available within each group.
parameters.n_bar_total_items: <int> Total number of candidate items across all groups.

capacities: <list[int], length m_resources> Maximum available amount of each shared resource.

items.item_id: <int> Zero-based identifier of this item within its group.
items.profit: <int> Reward earned when this item is selected.
items.weights: <list[int], length m_resources> Amount of each shared resource consumed by this item.
